title: Adolescent Tdap booster: 1 dose of Tdap for adolescents aged 13-18 (routine at 11-12, catch-up at 13-18)
action: Administer 1 dose of Tdap (adolescent booster) to adolescents aged 13-18 who have not received Tdap

denominator.quote: Age 13–18 years who have not received Tdap

derived.window: The text gives no look-back period. Any prior Tdap counts, so the window covers the lifetime of an 18-year-old (MY-18 through end of MY). This is an approximation: Tdap given at age 7-9 should not count (see coverage_notes), and age at dose is not checked.
